comments.text:
Sir i beg to disagree with the sheer hopefullness from these results. 

1) Since bank’s business is not cyclical therefore should not it be right to compare with last qtr and not the last year.

2) A good portion of the profit was acquired from selling assets. The reason to this may be to prevent stock from falling as bank had to raise capital. In a nutshell, the rise in profits can not be attributed to growth in business. Shouldn’t it be seen as weekness!

3) Banks are conveniently declaring NPA’s as suo motto for timebeing because of ongoing moritorium. Banks themselves really do not know how much pain is actually there in the bank. Macro economic parameters do not look v healthy, not sure what %age of the loans under moritorium will be paid by the borowers.

4) Commentory by CEO should be taken with a pinch of salt as these are global statments given by most of the banks’ CEO in these times. I would not believe these actions just by the statements but it should reflect in their next qtryly results.

Having said above point, i agree that stock can go to 500, bit only iff operator wants us to take it but i am not very confident that fundamentals of ICICI support levels of 500.

That was my opinion sir. I beg again to differ with you here. Thanks anyways for bringing me to this level where i can think as an independent mind.
